text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Hosted API (us-east-1) p99 latency spike >10s, queued requests=36,200. Autoscaler reports repeated provisioning failures (quota_denied, API rate limit). Marking sev-high.

Alex (oncall): seeing >2000 requests/s sustained. Autoscaler logs show 429 from cloud provider on instance create.

Priya: on it. I can take lead, Alex hand off in 5. What do we know about quota?

Nate: looks like soft GPU quota for tenant pool hit. Cloud response: "quota limit reached for gpu-v100-family". Also saw provisioner retries backoff.

Li: confirming provider quotas across accounts: us-east-1 zone A exhausted. We have spare capacity in zone B and in eu-west but cross-zone placement isn't enabled for this fleet.

Tess (CS): Customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reporting 504s (batch jobs and realtime chat). Support ticket IDs: #9871, #9872, #9875. They're seeing p95/p99 errors.

Jason: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant, 2) enable route-level rate limiting to shed bursty clients, 3) trigger manual placement to zone B if possible.

Priya: executing mitigations in parallel. Nate, can you flip the model fallback?

Nate: yes. Pushing quick config: set MODEL_FALLBACK=redwood/small-quant for hosted default. This will reduce GPU memory and per-token latency.

Priya: applying temporary edge rate-limit for public routes: throttle=100r/s per API key for 10m. Pushing now.

ops-bot: @channel action: updated rate_limit for /v1/generate -> 100r/s, scope=api_key, duration=10m.

Alex (oncall): handing off to Priya. I'm available for escalation. Priya you're primary.

Priya: taking primary. Next I'm going to try a manual provision to zone B. Li, can you allow cross-zone placement for the provisioner?

Li: patching provisioner config to allow zone_hint=auto (zone B preferred). Pushing CL.

Priya: manual provisioning attempt: 
```
# manual create attempt
cloudctl instances create --type gpu-v100 --zone us-east-1b --count 6 --tags hosted-provisioner
```

Priya: cloudctl returning: ERROR quota_denied for account. Still quota-blocked. Trying delegated account path to spin on dedicated pool.

Nate: while infra works quotas, enabling model fallback is already reducing p99 at edge for some routes. p95 dropped from ~3.4s -> 1.2s on canary.

Tess (CS): telling impacted customers we have partial mitigation: fallback to smaller model, temporary rate limits. They're asking about ETA for full recovery.

Kiran: product asks: can we route critical enterprise tenants to dedicated capacity (reserved) as emergency? That would minimize impact for paying customers.

Jason: yes—if dedicated pools exist for those tenants. We can failover specific tenant routes to dedicated if their dedicated_pools flag is set. Manual switch prepared: 
```
PATCH /v1/routes/:tenant_id
{ "pool": "dedicated-emergency" }
```

Priya: switching tenant-42 and tenant-88 now.

ops-bot: route update succeeded for tenant-42, tenant-88.

Tess (CS): tenant-42 confirming degraded but functional. tenant-88 still has intermittent errors but improved.

Nate: autoscaler: we discovered a bug where backoff multiplier doubles on each transient 429 leading to long stall. Created temp fix: reduce max backoff and add jitter. Deploying to provisioner.

Priya: deploying provisioner fix (hotfix). Rolling patch to provisioner pods.

Alex (oncall): quick sanity: any signs of cascading failures (control plane restarts, leader elections)?

Li: small leader churn during hotfix; stable now. No long-term control plane degradation.

Priya: provisioner hotfix live. Manual retries for pending create jobs now initiating. Observability: queued requests dropping from 36,200 -> 9,800 in last 8m. p99 trending down.

incident-bot: UPDATE: queued requests=9,780, p99=2.8s, p95=700ms. Autoscaler create success rate improving.

Priya: continuing to monitor. Next steps: 1) follow up with cloud provider on permanent quota bump, 2) schedule runbook to enable cross-zone failover permanently, 3) post-incident RCA on autoscaler backoff bug.

Tess (CS): sending customer update: partial mitigation deployed, estimated full recovery in 1-2 hours while we request quota increase and stabilize.

Kiran: prepare a short external status for customers and internal postmortem notes. Assigning RCA owners: Nate (autoscaler), Li (infra/quota), Priya (runbook).

Priya: handing back to Alex for next shift in 30m. Alex, please keep watch for resurgence.

Alex (oncall): ack. I'll monitor p99 and queued requests. If queued >15k again, re-alert and escalate to execs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated (partial). Next update scheduled +30m. Link: /incidents/1019876543 (postmortem pending).

Priya: closing this thread for active coordination. I'll create an ops follow-up ticket with links to logs and the fix CLs.

Jason: noted. Great quick work everyone. :thumbsup:
